title: What is the average amount of credit card withdrawals made in 1998 by male
question: What is the average amount of credit card withdrawals made in 1998 by male clients born between 1974 and 1976 who live in districts with average salaries over $10,000? Include only those clients who are account owners.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(T6."XCL_051")
FROM card AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2."XCL_014" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T3."XCL_012" = T4."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN account AS T5 ON T2."XCL_015" = T5."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN trans AS T6 ON T5."XCL_001" = T6."XCL_047"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T6."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND T6."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND T3."XCL_010" = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_011") BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976'
  AND T2."XCL_016" = 'OWNER'
  AND T4."XCL_017" IN (SELECT "XCL_017" FROM district WHERE "XCL_027" > 10000)

JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district dist ON c.XCL_012 = dist.XCL_017
WHERE t.XCL_053 = 'withdrawal'
  AND t.XCL_049 = 'card'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND c.XCL_010 = 'M'
  AND c.XCL_011 BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND dist.XCL_028 > 10000
  AND d.XCL_016 = 'owner'

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT AVG(T6."XCL_051")
FROM card AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2."XCL_014" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T3."XCL_012" = T4."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN account AS T5 ON T2."XCL_015" = T5."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN trans AS T6 ON T5."XCL_001" = T6."XCL_047"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T6."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND T6."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND T3."XCL_010" = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_011") BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976'
  AND T2."XCL_016" = 'OWNER'
  AND T4."XCL_017" IN (SELECT "XCL_017" FROM district WHERE "XCL_027" > 10000)
